verdict: DEAD at gate 0 (Bench(60,160) fast, kit-honest host checks + the relay's own hub 0 / link 0 metal): best 31.06 (azu 250 / a0 40, J0 axis outside the seat rule), best seat-rule placement 33.33 (azu 280 / a0 25); the host H1 alone scores 23.64 on the same bench. Every placement measured (31 configs over the whole a0 20-85 / azimuth 0-360 disc, T 20-60, stops 5-12) LOSES 7.4-150 points to the host: the J0 hub and link 0 cannot be placed on back / acromion-top skin without crossing hub 2's orbit about J1. Gate 0 kill line 17.5: not reached; a frozen exact wear cannot recover 13+ points (frozen loses points on every row on file). A geometric impossibility at the host's seats, not a tuning miss: the convergence gate is not run (no sweep can move hub 2's orbit). AUDIT (death STANDS): with no J0 metal at all and no seat rule the best of 40 placements is 18.30 fast (> 17.5 before any frozen-exact loss); the real metal at those placements scores 65-176.
limiter: hub 0 / link 0 vs hub 2's orbit. Hub 2 orbits J1 at a1 = 41 deg; over the 898 closing poses (1432-node envelope grid + fit clips, host H1 at q0 = 0) its azimuth about J1 covers every back / acromion-top direction (10-deg bins: 0-110 and 280-360 all populated; free sector 120-270 = in front of the acromion). A J0 hub needs a0 >= ~21 deg from J1 (hub 1 clearance) and either a0 <= a1 - 21 = 20 deg (inside the orbit: empty interval) or a0 >= 62 with link 0 crossing the orbit (L0-hub2 21-61 jams, L0-L1 28-57 jams, Bench(60,160) fast); placements inside the orbit's free sector are in front (seat rule x <= 0.2 / az <= 135 fails) or at the cap pole (T_eff cut to 15-16 deg by the J1 seat rule, 0-2 relayed poses taken, L1-hub0 6-12 jams). Back cell (proposer a0 35 phi 90): hub0-hub2 56-64 jams, gap 171-175; cap cell (a0 25 phi 60): L1-hub0 70 jams, gap 114.
